title: Quick Workout Routine
author: craig H.
desc: Get ready to maximize your fitness in just one week with this Quick Workout Routine! Designed for three days of focused training, this program targets all major muscle groups through a variety of machine and cable exercises, ensuring balanced strength development. Each session includes detailed sets and rep ranges, allowing you to push your limits while maintaining proper form. Perfect for those looking to fit effective workouts into a busy schedule, this plan will help you build strength and confidence in no time!

ex.note:
Warmup 2x10 
30 sec rest between warmup sets. 1:30 rest between work sets.
Warmup 1x10. 1 minute rest after warmup. 1:30 rest between sets.
Warmup 2x10. 1 minute rest between warmup sets. 2 minute rest between work sets on leg Press. 1:30 rest between sets on all other exercises
Glute bridges or abductor/ adductor machine as alternatives
